unsupported_claims.claim_text: This 38-week neonate presents with an intermediate risk for early-onset sepsis driven by prolonged rupture of membranes (20 hours) and elevated CRP (12.0 mg/L). Although the initial care setting was outpatient, the patient's history of hospitalization within the prior 14 days constitutes a critical contraindication to WHO outpatient regimens, necessitating immediate hospitalization for full inpatient management.
